payload.title: Compose hosted publication predictions over the guarded queue worker
payload.description: Implement the central application slice authorized by Ryan on2026-10-20 for Papyrus Monitoring: one shared remote multi-output engine, existing Prospectus account/role authorization, existing queue/worker and native S3 SDK storage. Bind account/publication/output/run revisions explicitly; use the same source revision for all publication projections. Papyrus consumer PR382 is green at603767e2. Reuse existing components and keep secrets out of config/records. No deployment, new infrastructure, credential creation or permission grants. Live models remain off by default; no labels, seeding or training. Normal sign-in with the explicitly selected ryan@anth.us reached a failed callback, so current account/role remains unverified. Keep that blocker visible; do not infer membership or weaken verification.
